_comment: 2026-07-26 Act V canonical, THE FIGHT PATH (one script per path, the door_chain_talk/fight/scout precedent). Loads seal_open_start (spellsword14 + the tuned gear, Act V already the derived act) via title Continue. Flow: the descent ask at Pisces' elbow on Market Street (banks seal_descent_agreed, starts what_the_seal_was_feeding, and CLOSES the pilgrimage spine's own `return` beat) -> teleport into trapped_halls (dungeon_peek's own teleport precedent; this route's subject is the seal, not the walk down) -> the SKILL-FREE reading, two bare interacts on seal_kept_door: Pisces matches the hand (read_the_seal_runes), then names the appetite (read_the_feeding_ward) -> his choice conversation -> WE OPEN IT (seal_opened) -> stepping to the door's only approach cell wakes the warden through its trigger_radius -> the tuned solo fight -> the door transitions for real (door_when) -> the vault: the anchor's open banks seal_resolved, grants the rubbing, and completes the quest. Fixture rng_state (seed 1) governs the warden fight and OVERRIDES --seed. FINALE LEG (Phase 8): this path's ending is delivered by the SLEEP hook, because its resolution banks at a container and never at a dialogue -- the run proves the curtain is silent on the walk out and rolls at the bed. It also carries the dialogue-filter NEGATIVE: an unrelated conversation (the peddler) opens and closes with the finale owed and draws no curtain.

steps._comment: Down to Continue; confirm loads the seal_open_start manual slot.

== ACT V IS ALREADY LIVE == the pilgrimage's third lattice piece plus the seal report is the act_iv gate, and this fixture holds both. The journal reads Act V before the player has done anything about it. act_beat_lines is the ENDING-SPOILER PIN (v0.15 A1): all three rows are '·' openings, so nothing on this page names what the seal holds or how it resolves -- the outcome `text` lines land only as their own counters bank.
steps.name: journal

act_beat_lines: · Pisces wants to read the seal in person, not from a treatise.
· The wardwork under Liscor is waiting to be read.
· What the seal keeps is still the seal's secret. Settle it.

steps._comment: == THE DESCENT ASK == Pisces (30,4). Bump up to face him; first interact = talk_pool line, second opens pisces_magic (spine_reach's own approach).

EXACT greet pin. The greeting is the lattice_forge_rune variant -- last-match-wins picks the newest discovery, and Act V's own two greet arms (seal_descent_agreed, seal_resolved) are correctly not yet reachable. Rows: the repeat lesson, the exit, the necromancy topic VISIBLE-LOCKED behind its class gate (the gating split: class/skill gates tease, accomplishment gates hide), and the descent ask last. Every door-chain arm is hide_when-retired and the spine arm is retired by spine_started.

payload_contains.speaker: Pisces
payload_contains.text: A Drake forge taught you in an afternoon what my tuition has been circling for a month. They feed their runes. Feed them, on a schedule. Maintenance, they call it. I am revising my rates. Downward. The new schedule is chalked on my slate already.

options.text: The other art. The one you actually practice. Teach me.
Everywhere I've been, someone was feeding a ward. Riverfarm, Invrisil, Pallass. Tell me what that means.
Ksmvr counts you as a Horn of Hammerad. Do you?

steps._comment: The pool-line panel is still closing as the graph opens; a confirm injected into that same frame is swallowed by its dismissal (cost one authoring cycle). Settle first, THEN drive the option cursor.
He assembles three regions' worth of the same word and asks to read the seal in person. The treatise leg is an OR-enrichment this save never took, so the base text is the one that renders.

payload_contains.speaker: Pisces
payload_contains.text: Three regions taught you the same word in three accents and not one of them noticed doing it. A witch feeds hers, milk and a word. An enchanter prices the draw and calls it craftsmanship. Pallass bills it as maintenance. Maintenance. Under this city is wardwork by the hand that cut our frame, and it has been drawing since before Liscor had walls. I want to read it standing in front of it.

steps._comment: descent_ask rows: 0 'What do you expect to find?', 1 the accept, 2 'Not today.'

The option's effects array is [quest, accomplishment] and the events land in that order -- the spine's own `return` beat completes on the accomplishment a beat later, closing the quest Phase 6 shipped open.
The spine's LAST beat completes on the same counter -- Phase 6 shipped `return` waiting on exactly this.

payload_contains.speaker: Pisces
payload_contains.text: Good. I have walked that gauntlet twice and marked the safe line myself, so we will not be dying of a flagstone. Bring your own rope. I am not carrying yours; I have a spine to preserve and a reputation that assumes I never lift anything.

steps._comment: == DOWN TO THE SEAL == teleport into trapped_halls at (18,8), one step off the door's approach cell. dungeon_peek's teleport precedent: the walk down is proven there and by delve_fight; this script's subject is the seal itself.

Act V's two new entities net to ZERO here and the count still moves: seal_warden_alcove (19,6) is an encounter, so it is visible and inert from first arrival (present_when is validator-forbidden on encounters), and pisces_seal_escort (19,8) is present since the descent was agreed -- while ksmvr_plates retires at horns_dig_joined, which this save banked long ago. 12 entities + the PC = 13, the same total dungeon_peek pins from the opposite direction (its fixture keeps Ksmvr and has no escort).

== READING 1: the hand == step onto the door's only approach cell (18,7), then bump right into seal_kept_door (19,7) to face it. The bump cannot move (a prop blocks its cell) but it sets facing -- the walkthroughs' own idiom.

payload_contains.text: Pisces reaches the door before you do and stops a handspan short of it. "The same hand. Not a school, not a fashion. A HAND, and it cut this one first." He does not look away while he says it.

steps._comment: == READING 2: the appetite == the SAME interact, one state later. Later-satisfied-wins across the prop's variants is what stages the two reads, and it is why a build with no reading Skill still gets the whole fact.
steps.name: interact

payload_contains.text: Pisces steps back at last. "It is not a lock. The lines run one way, they have run one way for a very long time, and something on the far side has been drinking the whole while. Your inn has a frame by this hand. Sleep well."

steps._comment: The toast QUEUE drains in order: without waiting for this one's own ui_toast_rendered the shot catches the rune-read line still on screen (windowed read 2026-07-27).

payload_contains.text: Pisces steps back at last. "It is not a lock. The lines run one way, they have run one way for a very long time, and something on the far side has been drinking the whole while. Your inn has a frame by this hand. Sleep well."

steps._comment: == THE CHOICE == back down to (18,8) and bump right into the escort (19,8). No talk_pool on that row, so the graph opens on the first interact.
at_the_door rows now: 0 the choice ('So what do we do about a door that eats?'), 1 'Take your moment.' The OR-bridge is hide_when-retired, the ward fact already being held.
steps.name: confirm

payload_contains.speaker: Pisces
payload_contains.text: We open it and see what three centuries of feeding produced. Or we leave it fed and make that somebody's paid duty, which is dull, and correct, and I resent both qualities. Or — if your hands are equal to it, which remains unproven — you re-cut the ward yourself and it holds another age without a keeper. I dislike most of these. I will be copying the outer lines while you decide.

steps._comment: the_choice rows: 0 open, 1 fed, 2 [Hedge Remedy] VISIBLE-LOCKED, 3 [Detect Magic] (this line inherits the mage grant, so it renders unlocked -- confirmed in the windowed read), 4 not yet. Skill gates tease; they never hide. Row 0 is the open, which is the fork this canonical takes.
steps.name: confirm

payload_contains.speaker: Pisces
payload_contains.text: Then stand clear of it. The reading has to stay open while the seal comes apart, which means I am occupied and you are on your own for whatever objects to this. Something will. Expect a guardian.

steps._comment: == THE WARDEN WAKES == stepping back onto (18,7) puts the player one cell off the alcove (19,6). encounter_when is met now, so trigger_radius 1 starts the fight without an interact -- the seal broke and the thing that guards it noticed.

== THE SEAL OPENS == the same door, the same interact, an entirely different mechanism: door_when is checked ahead of the interact arm, so this transitions instead of reading. Its open_toast fires BEFORE the map rebuild (interactions.gd's door_when branch order), the sewer_grate/deep_fissure precedent -- so the DOMAIN toast is asserted here, never its ui_toast_rendered.

payload_contains.text: The seal does not resist. It simply stops being a seal — the runes go quiet in order, one ring at a time, and the door swings in on three centuries of undisturbed air.

steps._comment: == THE ANCHOR == east along row 4 (the aisle between the statue pairs) to (7,4), then bump right into the plinth (8,4).

payload_contains.text: Not a prisoner. An ANCHOR — a twin to the stone the Horns hauled out of the ruin, and it has been drinking the ward's slow pour for three centuries to stay awake. Pisces, hoarse: "This is why the Door works at all. Somebody left it something to come home to, and then somebody sealed the room and let it drink."

steps._comment: == THE TALLY == the room's second read, down the aisle to the cut slab (5,7). Path avoids (7,6), which the statue pair blocks.

payload_contains.text: Cut into the slab, in a hand that expected readers: a tally. Ninety-one marks, then a gap, then one more in a different chisel. Nobody came back to make the ninety-third.

steps._comment: == BACK OUT == the return door (1,4) lands on trapped_halls (18,7), the approach cell this run walked in from. The warden is gone for good (no respawns flag), so nothing re-triggers on the way back.

== THE FINALE, DELIVERED OFF THE BED == this path banked seal_resolved at the vault's anchor -- a CONTAINER open, with no conversation behind it -- so the dialogue-end hook the TALK/SKILL paths use never fires here. The veil's sleep path is the second delivery hook and the one that cannot be routed around: teleport to your_bed's approach (inn_upstairs 9,2), bump up into the bed, sleep.
NEGATIVE, and the whole reason the sleep hook exists: walking out of the vault rolls no curtain by itself.

== NEGATIVE: AN UNRELATED CONVERSATION IS NOT A CURTAIN == (coordinator fix round 1) the dialogue-end hook is FILTERED to FINALE_CURTAIN_CONVERSATIONS, because on THIS path seal_resolved banked at a container and an unfiltered hook would credit-roll the next shopkeeper the player greets. The peddler (18,2) carries no talk_pool, so one interact opens peddler_stall directly.
Blocked by the peddler, so the PC stays at (18,3) and faces up into him.
Row 1 of the hub is 'Just looking.' (end: true). Rows 0/2/3 are the priced arms, visible at 40 gold.
THE PROOF: a full conversation opened and closed with the finale OWED, and the curtain stayed down.
